name: kong-gateway-agent
description: A VS Code extension to interact with a local Kong Gateway instance using LLM via OpenRouter.

kongAgent.provider.description: The AI API provider (OpenRouter or Local/Ollama)

kongAgent.openRouterApiKey.description: Your OpenRouter API Key for the LLM agent

kongAgent.geminiApiKey.description: Your Google Gemini API Key for the LLM agent

kongAgent.model.description: The LLM model name (e.g. openai/gpt-4o or llama3.1)

kongAgent.proxyPort.description: The local port for the Kong Proxy Gateway.

kongAgent.adminApiPort.description: The local port for the Kong Admin API.

kongAgent.managerGuiPort.description: The local port for the Kong Manager GUI.

kongAgent.databasePort.description: The local port for the Postgres Database.

kongAgent.maxToolDepth.description: Maximum tool call depth per message to prevent loops.

kongAgent.kongMode.description: The Kong instance type (Local Docker vs Remote URL).

kongAgent.remoteAdminApiUrl.description: The Admin API URL for the remote Kong instance.

kongAgent.remoteProxyBaseUrl.description: The Proxy Base URL for the remote Kong instance.

kongAgent.remoteManagerGuiUrl.description: The Manager GUI URL for the remote Kong instance.

kongAgent.storagePath.description: The absolute path to a folder where Kong configuration and Docker files will be stored.

kongAgent.gitRemoteUrl.description: The remote Git URL for the Kong configuration repository.

kongAgent.autoCommit.description: Automatically commit and push changes to Git after a successful decK sync.
